description: This file contains the implementation of various integer serializers (codecs) for the Orleans.Serialization framework, including codecs for primitive types like bool, char, byte, sbyte, ushort, short, uint, int, long, ulong, as well as extended types like Int128 and UInt128 for .NET 7 or greater. Each codec handles serialization and deserialization, with optimizations for different wire types and some support for length-prefixed encoding.

classes.name: BoolCodec
classes.description: Serializer for boolean values, using VarInt wire type and byte encoding.

classes.name: CharCodec
classes.description: Serializer for char, stored as VarUInt28.

classes.name: ByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for byte, stored as VarUInt28.

classes.name: SByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for sbyte, stored as VarInt8.

classes.name: UInt16Codec
classes.description: Serializer for ushort, stored as VarUInt28.

classes.name: Int16Codec
classes.description: Serializer for short, stored as VarInt16.

classes.name: UInt32Codec
classes.description: Serializer for uint, choosing between VarInt and Fixed32 based on value range.

classes.name: Int32Codec
classes.description: Serializer for int, using ZigZag encoding for VarInt representation.

classes.name: Int64Codec
classes.description: Serializer for long, choosing wire type based on value magnitude, with ZigZag encoding.

classes.name: UInt64Codec
classes.description: Serializer for ulong, choosing wire type based on value.

classes.name: Int128Codec
classes.description: Serializer for Int128, available on .NET 7+; encodes length-prefixed or as Int64 when fitting into 64 bits.

classes.name: UInt128Codec
classes.description: Serializer for UInt128, available on .NET 7+; encodes length-prefixed or as UInt64 when fitting into 64 bits.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the value with appropriate wire type, often using ZigZag or VarUInt encoding.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes the value from the reader, interpreting based on wire type.
